senses.gloss: (denom. of חָלָב) to milk; to yield milk.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:6">Ab. Zar. II, 6</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00966"><he>חָלָב</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 20b:7">Bekh. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>רוב … חוֹלְבוֹת וכ׳</he> the majority of animals secrete no milk unless they have given birth; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shabbat 53b:14">Sabb. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>לֵיחָלֵב</he> when the bag is tied on for milking purposes (to support the udders), opp. <he>ליבש</he> for drying up.
